subject.title: Effort/thinking level clamps are silent across all providers (no warning when xhigh/max is reduced)

question: Should thinking reductions become a stable structured result contract, a user-visible warning policy, or both across agent and spawn execution?
rationale: The remaining work changes public observability semantics and warning frequency across multiple execution surfaces; source inspection cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Metadata plus selective warning
options.body: Add requested, applied, and reason fields everywhere, with a deduplicated warning only for interactive or non-structured callers.

options.title: Structured metadata only
options.body: Expose the comparison consistently in results and diagnostics without adding user-facing warning noise.

options.title: Warnings only
options.body: Emit one-time warnings but avoid expanding the stable result metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Metadata plus selective warning
recommendation.body: Add requested, applied, and reason fields everywhere, with a deduplicated warning only for interactive or non-structured callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is the provider-thinking profile and gateway/UI alignment work in commit b3db7c6.
